guideText: What to know before requesting a quote Machin Solutions designs, builds and installs custom pergolas for patios, pool decks and outdoor kitchens. Based in Homestead, the business serves Miami-Dade, Broward and the Upper Keys. Project location, intended use and site conditions determine the scope of each proposal. What determines the price? A quote depends on dimensions, unsupported spans, height, materials, roof design, access and footing conditions. Lighting, fans and outdoor kitchen features also change the scope. We do not publish a square-foot rate: there is no verified price list for these custom projects. How should you compare proposals and schedules? Compare proposals with the same dimensions, materials, roof, footings, finishes and included work. Ask for written confirmation of who handles permits and electrical work, exclusions and warranty terms. Request a schedule that separates design, approvals, materials and installation; this site does not publish a confirmed standard lead time.  Evidence you can review The project gallery includes a cantilevered pergola with a media wall and a compact white two-post patio cover. The photographs show different roof, support and equipment layouts. Use them to explain what you want; prices, dimensions and outcomes for these projects have not been documented here. View photographs of our projects · Aluminum pergolas · Wood pergolas  How to start your enquiry Prepare the project city, photos of the space, rough dimensions, roof preference and intended use. Contact us by phone or email; the form does not yet send enquiries. Confirm any site-visit or estimate fee before booking. (786) 775-0816 · machindavid2@gmail.com · Check service areas
